verdict.rationale: LangSmith's own docs list LLM-as-judge as a first-party evaluator type for scoring performance on datasets and experiments, and as a reference-free LLM-as-judge that runs automatically on production traces. The only documented configuration is filters and sampling rates on those online evaluators; configuring the judge itself is not shown. missing for 10: documented configuration of the judge prompt, rubric, model choice and score format, plus independent or hands-on corroboration that LLM-as-judge scoring works as described.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can score outputs with configurable LLM-as-a-judge evaluators

citations.quote: Create evaluators to score performance: Human review, Code rules, LLM-as-judge, Pairwise comparison
